A '''plasma charge''' was an explosive device generating high-temperature [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] shockwaves. It was produced by [[Tarascii Explosives/Legends|Tarascii Explosives]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="DC" />
